published.title: Ride Published
published.body: Your ride has been published and is visible to riders.

autoCancelled.title: Ride cancelled
autoCancelled.body: {{reason}}, so we cancelled it for you.

changed.title: Your ride has changed
changed.time: Your driver moved the departure to {{when}}. If that no longer works, you can cancel for a full refund.
changed.seats: Your driver changed the seats of your ride.
changed.price: Your driver changed the price of your ride.
changed.several: Your driver changed the {{fields}} of your ride.

started.title: Your driver is on the way
started.body: Your ride has started. Open Poolora to follow the car live.

requested.title: New Booking Request
requested.push: You have a new ride booking request. Tap to review.
requested.body: A rider has requested to join your ride.

confirmed.title: Booking Confirmed
confirmed.body: Your seat is confirmed. At pickup, tell the driver the 4-digit code on your ride screen, and get in only when your app says it is confirmed.

arrived.title: Your driver has arrived
arrived.body: Your driver is at the pickup and will wait {{minutes}} minutes. Check the plate, then tell them your pickup code.

noShow.title: Marked as a no-show
noShow.body: Your driver waited at the pickup and left without you. The fare is not refunded; raise a dispute from My rides if this is wrong.

payment.seatRequestBody: A rider has paid for a seat and is waiting for you to accept.
payment.parcelRequestBody: A parcel is waiting for you to accept. Tracking: {{tracking}}
payment.toWalletBody: Your {{amount}} payment arrived after the request had closed or was already paid, so it is in your Poolora wallet. You can use it or withdraw it.

contacts.raisedAgain: Poolora SOS: {{name}} has raised their emergency alert again. See where they are: {{url}} If they may be in danger, call {{number}}.
contacts.raised: Poolora SOS: {{name}} raised an emergency alert during a ride. See where they are: {{url}} If they may be in danger, call {{number}} (police {{police}}).
contacts.pushBody: Tap to see where they are.
contacts.safe: Poolora: {{name}} says they are safe now. Our safety team is checking with them.
contacts.closed: Poolora: the emergency alert for {{name}} has been closed by our safety team.

user.acknowledgedTitle: The safety team has your SOS
user.acknowledgedNamed: {{name}} from the Poolora safety team is on it and will call you.
user.acknowledged: The Poolora safety team is on it and will call you.
user.closedBody: The Poolora safety team has closed your alert. If you need help again, raise a new SOS or call {{number}}.
user.videoAskTitle: The safety team would like to see
user.videoAskBody: If it is safe, open the SOS screen and turn on your camera. Your phone will make no sound.

checkIn.title: Are you OK?
checkIn.bodyRepeat: We did not hear back. Tap to answer, or we will alert the safety team.
checkIn.body: A quick safety check during your ride. Tap to answer.
checkIn.escalatedTitle: We have alerted the Poolora safety team
checkIn.escalatedBody: You did not answer two safety check-ins. Tap to tell us you are OK, or we will text your emergency contacts in {{minutes}} minutes.

approach.nearTitle: Your driver is about 5 minutes away
approach.nearBody: Get ready at the pickup point.

deviation.title: Your car has left the planned route
deviation.body: The car is about {{meters}} m off the planned route. Open Poolora to follow it, or use SOS if you feel unsafe.

pickupPin.lockedTitle: Check the car before you get in
pickupPin.lockedBody: Five wrong pickup codes were entered for your ride.{{plate}} If you are in the right car, tap "I'm in the car".

rating.thanksIssue: Thanks for rating your trip. Our team will look at the problem you reported.
rating.thanks: Thanks for rating your trip. It helps keep Poolora safe and friendly.
rating.reminderBody: Rate your trip. It takes a few seconds and helps other riders.

contacts.verifyText: {{name}} added you as an emergency contact on Poolora. If they raise an SOS on a ride, you'll get a text with their live location. Please confirm: {{url}}
contacts.confirmedBody: {{name}} confirmed they are your emergency contact.

parcel.acceptedBody: Your parcel has been accepted by the driver. Tracking: {{tracking}}
parcel.pickedUpBody: Your parcel has been picked up. Tracking: {{tracking}}
parcel.deliveredBody: Your parcel has been delivered. Tracking: {{tracking}}
parcel.declinedBody: The driver could not take your parcel.
parcel.declinedRefund: The driver could not take your parcel. {{amount}} is back in your Poolora wallet.

trip.joinRequestTitle: Someone wants to join your trip
trip.acceptedBody: You joined "{{trip}}". Say hello to the group!
trip.declinedBody: The organizer of "{{trip}}" could not take you this time.
trip.paymentBody: A payment of {{amount}} was marked settled.
trip.voteBody: A new activity was proposed for "{{trip}}". Vote yes, no or maybe.

identity.approvedWoman: Your identity check is approved. You can now post and book women-only rides.
identity.rejectedBody: {{reason}} You can send it again from Profile > Identity check.

withdrawal.sentBody: {{amount}} has been sent to your {{wallet}} {{number}}. Reference {{reference}}.

account.pausedBody: We paused your account while our team checks some unusual payment activity. This usually takes a few hours. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
account.mergedBody: Your other Poolora account (phone ending {{lastFour}}) has been merged into this one. Its trips, ratings and wallet balance are now here.

email.subject: Confirm your work email for {{company}} on Poolora
email.body: Hi {{name}}. Confirm this address to join the {{company}} programme on Poolora, so you can share rides with colleagues.
email.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Nothing changes until the address is confirmed.

work.joinedBody: You are now part of the {{company}} programme on Poolora.
